source.author: verg
source.text: praesensit, motusque excepit prima futuros, omnia tuta timens.
source.text_original: praesensit, motusque excepit prima futuros, / omnia tuta timens.
source.text_english: she foresaw it and first caught the future movements, fearing that all was safe.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Saluta Blesillam et Eustochium, tirunculas nostras; saluta Felicianen, uere carnis et spiritus uirginitate felicem; saluta reliquum castitatis chorum et domesticam tuam ecclesiam, cui omnia, etiam quae tuta sunt, timeo, ne dormiente patre familias inimicus homo zizania superseminet.
reuse.text_original: Saluta Blesillam et Eustochium, tirunculas nostras; saluta Felicianen, uere carnis et spiritus uirginitate felicem; saluta reliquum castitatis chorum et domesticam tuam ecclesiam, cui omnia, etiam quae tuta sunt, timeo, ne dormiente patre familias inimicus homo zizania superseminet.
reuse.text_english: Greet Blesilla and Eustochium, our young beginners; greet Feliciane, truly blessed in the virginity of flesh and spirit; greet the rest of the choir of chastity and your household church, for whom I fear everything, even what is safe, lest, while the master of the house sleeps, the enemy man should sow weeds among them.
